count_scope.name: block-trailing
count_scope.scalar_strict_audit: also report sum_k |L_rows(k)|*|U_cols(k)| before block filtering

address_layout.A_order: column-major, row-sorted scalar targets of the selected block-trailing sparse product
address_layout.record_layout: AoS: fp32 value followed by int32 index
address_layout.line_attribution: record start address; each 8-byte record belongs to one 64-byte line

operation_vliw.reference: OOLU, IEEE Transactions on Computers, 2025, DOI 10.1109/TC.2025.3605751
operation_vliw.task_definition: one VLIW bundle issues 16 scalar operations; final incomplete bundle is represented with padding slots
operation_vliw.cache_trace_effect: scalar event order and L/U/A accesses are unchanged; only task/dependency cardinality and normalized control metadata are bundled

traversal_order.operation: 16-lane VLIW bundles over the k,i,j lexicographic scalar stream
traversal_order.operation_block_order: 16-lane VLIW bundle cardinality with the exact block (I,J,K),k,i,j scalar atom order
traversal_order.segment_cache_aware: one ascending-j queue head per segment; select maximum resident L/U/A footprint, tie by (j,s)

descriptor_model_note: normalized model: 8x32-bit words/task plus 2x32-bit words/dependency; not claimed as OOLU's literal instruction encoding

metadata_interpretation.footprint: static storage required by the normalized descriptor representation
metadata_interpretation.stream_each_run: upper-bound model that fetches the full footprint on every factorization
metadata_interpretation.preload_once: footprint divided by the number of repeated numerical factorizations
metadata_interpretation.online_generate: zero external metadata bytes; generator compute/storage cost is explicitly excluded
